street.description: TikTok-native, hyper-current Gen Z. Half-life of slang is ~6-18 months.

casual_social.description: Cleaner Gen Z social voice for brand-owned channels.

gen_z_internet_slang: tell me you're _ without telling me

grammar_quirks: Sentence fragments are the dominant rhythm
Lowercase as aesthetic ('this is really sending me')
Caps for emphasis on a single word ('this is REAL')

rules: Many Gen Z phrases originated in AAVE (slay, period, bet, no cap) — use with awareness; see aave_english pack
Slang half-life is short — verify any term older than 18 months
Don't combo more than 2-3 Gen Z slang terms per sentence — feels try-hard

do_not_use: Combining 4+ Gen Z markers in one sentence — instant brand-trying-too-hard signal
Brand voice that sounds like an adult writing what they think Gen Z says

example_translations.correct_native_genz: ok bestie this is actually sending me
example_translations.note: Pair with restraint — one Gen Z marker per sentence beats four.
